blocks.text: Nylon aik synthetic (insan ka banaya hua) polyamide hai. Yeh condensation polymerisation se banta hai, aam tor par do mukhtalif monomers se: aik diamine aur aik dicarboxylic acid. Reaction ke dauran aik chhota molecule, aam tor par paani, nikal jata hai. Aam tor par diamine (H₂N-R-NH₂) aur dicarboxylic acid (HOOC-R-COOH) monomers hote hain.

Nylon 6,6 synthetic amides ki sab se aam misal hai. Nylon 6,6 hexane-1,6-diamine (1,6-diaminohexane) aur hexanedioic acid (adipic acid) ke polymerisation reaction se banta hai, jaise neeche dikhaya gaya hai. Dono monomers mein chhe chhe carbon atoms hain, isi liye naam 6,6 hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab is acid ko '1,4-hexanedioic acid' likhti hai. Adipic acid, HOOC-(CH₂)₄-COOH, ke dono COOH carbons chain ke C1 aur C6 hain, is liye sahi naam hexanedioic acid (hexane-1,6-dioic acid) hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar ki qataar: H2N-(CH2)6-NH2, HOOC-(CH2)4-COOH, H2N-(CH2)6-NH2, HOOC-(CH2)4-COOH, har aik ke N-H, C=O aur OH bonds ke saath. Teer se zanjeer ...-NH-(CH2)6-NH-C(=O)-(CH2)4-C(=O)-NH-(CH2)6-NH-C(=O)-(CH2)4-C(=O)-..., pehli unit magenta mein, aur chaaron C=O ke neeche +H2O.
blocks.caption: Nylon-6,6 ki tayyari (kitab ke PDF safha 150 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Magenta hissa aik repeat unit hai: aik diamine aur aik diacid. Har -NH₂ ka H aur har -COOH ka OH mil kar paani bante hain, is liye har C=O ke neeche +H₂O likha hai. Kitab ki chhapi chain mein teesre N aur (CH₂)₆ ke darmiyan bond chhoot gaya hai; drawing mein yeh bond lagaya gaya hai.
Kitab ki tasveer mein aik skateboard hai jis ke pahiye nylon ke bane hain, kyun ke nylon sakht, hamwar (smooth) hai aur jhatke (shock) bardasht karta hai.

Nylon ki aik aur qism nylon-6 hai, jo sirf aik monomer, caprolactam, se banta hai. Is ka naam nylon-6 is liye hai ke monomer mein chhe carbon atoms hain. Caprolactam ki banawat cyclic (ring ki shakal) hai. Yeh aam condensation reaction nahi, kyun ke reaction mein koi chhota molecule nahi nikalta. Phir bhi amide linkage banne ke tareeqe ki wajah se nylon-6 ko condensation polymer mana jata hai.

blocks.alt: Teen caprolactam halqe, har aik C(=O), N(H) aur paanch CH2 groups ka saat rukni halqa. Teer se zanjeer ...C(=O)-(CH2)5-NH-C(=O)-(CH2)5-NH-C(=O)-(CH2)5-NH..., aakhri unit hari, naam Nylon 6.
blocks.caption: Caprolactam se nylon-6 ka banna (kitab ke PDF safha 150 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Caprolactam ki ring C-N bond par khulti hai aur khuli rings aapas mein jur jati hain; koi chhota molecule nahi nikalta. Hari unit aik khula hua caprolactam hai: -C(=O)-(CH₂)₅-NH-.

Nylon 6, nylon-6,6 se zyada sakht hai, is ki satah zyada hamwar hai aur yeh chot (impact) zyada bardasht karta hai, yani maarne se mushkil se toot'ta hai. Is ka melting point nylon-6,6 se kam hai, is liye ise saanche mein dhalna (mold karna) aasan hai. Yeh zyada tar rollers, skateboard ke pahiyon aur power tools ke handles mein jhatkon se bachane ke liye use hota hai.

blocks.prompt: a) Nylon-6,10 ka repeating unit neeche diya hai. Is se monomers ki structures banayein.
blocks.explanation: Hexane-1,6-diamine, H₂N-(CH₂)₆-NH₂, aur decanedioic acid, HOOC-(CH₂)₈-COOH (ya is ka dioyl chloride, ClOC-(CH₂)₈-COCl). Diamine mein 6 carbon aur acid mein 10 carbon hain, isi liye naam 6,10 hai.

blocks.prompt: b) Nylon-6,4 ke monomers neeche diye hain. In se banne wale polymer ka repeating unit banayein.
blocks.explanation: [-NH-(CH₂)₆-NH-CO-(CH₂)₂-CO-]ₙ. Har jor par aik H₂O nikalta hai.

items: Nylon synthetic polyamide hai: diamine + dicarboxylic acid, paani nikalta hai.
Nylon-6: caprolactam ki ring khulti hai; koi chhota molecule nahi nikalta; rollers aur skateboard wheels.
